content.description: Illustration showing removal of cowl side trim board scuff plate screw

content.text: 11. REMOVE PASSENGER SIDE COWL SIDE TRIM BOARD

items: (b) Remove the four screws and cowl side trim board.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of passenger side instrument panel under cover with three screws

content.text: 12. REMOVE PASSENGER SIDE INSTRUMENT PANEL UNDER COVER
Remove the three screws and the under cover.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of passenger side finish lower panel assembly with glove compartment door open

content.text: 14. REMOVE PASSENGER SIDE FINISH LOWER PANEL ASSEMBLY

items: (a) Remove the glove compartment door check arm and the compartment door.

content.text: NOTE: If necessary, remove the speaker.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of ECU (Electronic Control Unit) with three connectors and three screws

items: (b) Remove the three screws and the ECU.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of four screws from heater control assembly

content.text: 16. REMOVE SCREWS OF HEATER CONTROL ASSEMBLY
Remove the four screws of the heater control assembly.
NOTE: Do not disconnect the heater control cable.
